notes.title: Free updates for new content are available!
notes.content:
Dear users,
A new patch has been updated.


- New 2 Dungeons

[img]https://i0.wp.com/grumpyent.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/0527_2.jpg[/img]

- New Currency and custom shops

[img]https://i0.wp.com/grumpyent.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/0527_1.jpg[/img]

- Difficulty setting after the ending

[img]https://i0.wp.com/grumpyent.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/0527_3.jpg[/img]

- System stabilization and performance improvements


[In addition to this...] 
we'll be improving voice dubbing and translations at a cost equal to the total of the Steam revenue.
This will probably... be an update in a month or two.

You've been waiting a long time. 
From the bottom of our hearts, we thank you all.


Thank you for visiting the department store!

notes.title: [01/23] Urgent Patch
notes.content:
Dear users, 
An emergency fix patch has been updated.

Of the requests we received over the past day, these are the quickest fixes we could make.

1. Add Cutscene skips
2. Give HP potions at the spawn
3. You can return to the main menu after saving from the pause state
4. Description [Mutant Mode -> Easy Mode]
5. Weaker enemies in the early game

We promise to keep updating the game as best we can to ensure everyone.

Thank you for visiting the department store.

notes.title: First Updates to Disorder: Demo
notes.content:
We've received tons of feedback from our proud users over the past few days and updated the 'disorder:demo'

1. We're revealing a new weapon, ROTO.
2. bug fix: Fixed BGM error in boss room.

We look forward to seeing you at Steam NEXT Fest!

Thank you as always,
